verdict.rationale: treg's own tutorial documents choosing which tools each team member may use, and whether they may run CLIs locally, at invite time or later. That is a first-party per-tool access control, but it is scoped to members rather than explicitly to agents, and its granularity is not detailed. missing for 10: explicit per-agent or per-token tool allowlists, per-endpoint/operation-level restriction within a tool, server/provider-level allowlist configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict which servers and individual tools an agent may call through allowlists or per-tool access control

citations.quote: choose **which tools each member may use** and whether they may run CLIs **locally**, at invite time or any time later.
